units.source_text: [\[1\]](#part1330.html#w1) 妃嫔中地位最高的是女御，其次为更衣，皆侍寝。

en.t: Among the imperial consorts, the nyogo held the highest rank, followed by the koi; all of them attended the emperor in his bedchamber.

units.source_text: 又次为尚侍（亦可侍寝）、典侍、掌侍、命妇等女官。

en.t: Below them came female officials such as the naishi no kami, who could also attend the emperor in bed, the naishi no suke, the naishi no jo, and the myobu.

units.source_text: 尚侍为内侍司（后宫十二司之一）的长官，典侍为次官，掌侍为三等官，命妇又次之。

en.t: The naishi no kami was the chief officer of the Naishi-no-tsukasa, one of the twelve offices of the inner palace; the naishi no suke was the deputy, the naishi no jo was the third-ranking officer, and the myobu ranked below them.
